text:
Alicia: hey team — we officially crossed 50,000,000 monthly requests 🎉🧪
Matt: wait what??? that timeline flew by. congrats everyone!! :tada:
Devin: huge props to infra for no meltdown during the spike. ops-bot saved us.
Ops-bot: Alert suppressed: autoscaler handled a 3.1x traffic burst. No action required. :robot_face:
Sara: neon socks + late-night pizza to celebrate? (i vote yes)
Jamie: i will bring pineapple-on-half pizza and a euphoric playlist. opinions on the other half?
Leo: olives. always olives. also can we get a quick shoutout thread for folks who stayed overnight?
Nora: shoutout to @Devin and @Kim for the 2am kernel patch. legend status. :sparkles:
Kim: aw shucks. team effort — couldn't have done it without the batching tweaks you shipped, Devin.
Matt: can someone make a 5-song playlist? title proposal: "50M & Neon Socks"
Alicia: poll: reaction 👍 = pizza, reaction 🎧 = playlist-only afterhours, reaction 🎈 = both.
Devin: also minor note — one job had elevated latency for ~6m, but we routed failures to the next tier automatically. filed a short blameless note in #incidents.
Nora: ordering window: who can pick up at 7:15pm? 
Jamie: i can pick up. will grab extra napkins and non-pineapple options.
Leo: GIF: (tiny dancing sock gif)
Alicia: perfect. logistics set. posting confetti in #announcements after we finish pizza pics. thank you everyone — this is wild. :confetti_ball:
Kim: selfie from the kitchen table incoming!
Matt: quick math: 50M requests ~= 3.2x last quarter. this is growth we can celebrate and iterate on. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ops-bot: Reminder: please tag any customer-facing screenshots with redaction_label before posting.
Sara: noted. will blur tokens.
Alicia: okay closing with one more thank you and a goofy ask — neon socks mandatory?
All: :neon_socks: (not a real emoji but imagine it)
